name: Corpse Reviver No. 1
description: Cognac, calvados and sweet vermouth stirred. The darker, boozier sibling of the No. 2. Needs cognac and calvados.
history: Harry Craddock’s Savoy Cocktail Book (1930) lists it as a “hair of the dog,” to be taken before 11 a.m. or whenever steam and energy are needed.
whyItWorks: Grape brandy and apple brandy together are rounder than either alone; sweet vermouth ties them together the way it does in a Manhattan.
steps: Stir cognac, calvados and sweet vermouth with ice until very cold.
Strain into a chilled coupe and express an orange twist.
techniqueNotes: Until both brandies are in, make the Corpse Reviver No. 2 instead.

recommendedBottles.rationale: The vermouth is already on the shelf.

substitutions.notes: All cognac works if you only buy one bottle; it loses the apple.
